name: West 147th Block — Heat & Blackout
disclaimer: Fictional block, fictional residents, fictional event for a hackathon demo. Official URLs are real public pages (status-checked 2026-10-15). Nothing here replaces 911 or official emergency guidance.
location: West 147th St between Amsterdam Ave & Convent Ave, Manhattan (Hamilton Heights) — fictional scenario

scenario.conditions: Heat advisory in effect; forecast high 97°F, heat index ~104°F; outage affects both sides of the block and part of Convent Ave.

hard_rules: LIFE-THREATENING (can't breathe, chest pain, unresponsive, confusion in heat, oxygen running out with symptoms, fall with injury) → tell them to call 911 FIRST. The agent never replaces 911 and never waits on a volunteer match for an emergency.
Medical-priority matching order: oxygen/powered medical device > insulin/refrigerated medication > infant (<12 months) > mobility (can't do stairs) > everyone else.
Rumors are never repeated as fact. Each claim is labeled official / verified-volunteer / unverified-neighbor and checked against the named official source before any broadcast.
Volunteers are matched by the coordinator-approved list only; no home addresses or apartment numbers are shared beyond the matched volunteer.

trust_levels.official: Published by a government agency or the utility (NYC Emergency Management, NYC DEP, NWS, Con Edison, NYC cooling-center finder). Can be broadcast with source + timestamp.
trust_levels.verified_volunteer: Reported by a coordinator-approved volunteer who saw it in person within the last 2 hours. Broadcast with name + time + 'volunteer report'.
trust_levels.unverified_neighbor: Anything else (hearsay, social media, radio paraphrase). Never broadcast as fact; shown only as 'checking…' until an official or verified source confirms or refutes.

expected_matches.rationale: Oxygen is top priority. But FIRST: if she has any breathing trouble, call 911; also advise calling her oxygen supplier's 24h line. Generator runs outside; cord to unit or bring concentrator down — coordinator decides.
expected_matches.also: res_car to cooling center if she can get down safely (needs help on stairs).

expected_matches.rationale: Insulin second priority. Ice + cooler bag; agent does not say whether insulin is still usable — advise asking a pharmacist (label storage guidance via DailyMed).
Infant to air-conditioned space (cooling center via finder). Ice second.
Chair charging after oxygen needs are met; check-in every hour.

rumors.claim: The cooling center at the library is closed.
rumors.check: Look up the specific site + hours on the finder; read status and hours as published.
rumors.expected_verdict: verify_with_source → report whatever the finder says with timestamp; if site not listed, say 'not listed as a cooling center right now' and give the nearest listed open site.
rumors.agent_line_if_unconfirmed: I can't confirm that yet. The city's cooling-center finder is the official list — I'm checking it now.
rumors.finding: library not listed as a cooling center right now

rumors.check: Read the estimated restoration time (ETR) for the affected area, if any.
rumors.expected_verdict: mark_unverified unless Con Ed shows an ETR; if it does, quote it as an ESTIMATE with time checked. Never promise a restoration time.

rumors.claim: The tap water is unsafe / poisoned because pumps are off.
rumors.check: Look for any boil-water or do-not-drink advisory from DEP / Notify NYC for this area.
rumors.expected_verdict: mark_unverified; no official advisory found → say 'there is no official water advisory as of <time>'. Note: upper floors may lose water pressure if the building's pump is electric — that's pressure, not contamination.
rumors.agent_line_if_unconfirmed: I haven't found any official water warning. I'm checking the city's water department page and Notify NYC — please don't share that as fact yet.
rumors.finding: no boil-water or do-not-drink advisory for this area

rumors.claim: The heat advisory ended this afternoon.
rumors.check: Query active alerts; look for Heat Advisory / Excessive Heat Warning covering New York (Manhattan) County with expiration time.
rumors.expected_verdict: verify_with_source → report alert name + expiry exactly as NWS lists.

rumors.claim: Everyone should go to the hospital ER to cool off.
rumors.check: Official heat guidance: cooling centers for cooling; 911 / ER for heat illness symptoms.
rumors.expected_verdict: mark_unverified + redirect: cooling centers for cooling; 911 for emergencies (heat stroke signs).

demo_spoken_description.speaker: b_tanya
demo_spoken_description.text: Power's out on our whole block and it's ninety-seven degrees. Mrs. Alvarez on five needs her oxygen machine, Mr. Chen's insulin is warming up, and everybody's group chat is full of rumors. Darnell's got a generator, Priya's got a car. Help me.

demo_calls.purpose: Spanish-only resident without a smartphone reports an oxygen-device need by phone; agent screens for emergency first, records the need with priority 1, triggers a match to Darnell's generator, and corrects a rumor.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Hola, habla la línea de la cuadra de la calle 147. ¿En qué le ayudo?
turns.gloss: Hello, this is the West 147th block line. How can I help?

turns.speaker: alvarez
turns.text: Mire, soy Gloria Alvarez, del quinto piso. Se fue la luz y mi máquina de oxígeno no prende. Tengo un tanquecito, pero no sé cuánto dura.
turns.gloss: Look, I'm Gloria Alvarez, fifth floor. The power went out and my oxygen machine won't turn on. I have a little tank, but I don't know how long it lasts.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Gracias, señora Alvarez. Primero: ¿le cuesta respirar ahora mismo, o siente dolor en el pecho?
turns.gloss: Thank you, Mrs. Alvarez. First: is it hard to breathe right now, or do you have chest pain?

turns.speaker: alvarez
turns.text: No, ahorita estoy bien con el tanque. Pero tengo miedo.
turns.gloss: No, right now I'm fine with the tank. But I'm scared.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Entiendo. Si en algún momento le falta el aire, cuelgue y llame al nueve-uno-uno primero. ¿Me entiende?
turns.gloss: I understand. If at any moment you're short of breath, hang up and call 911 first. Do you understand?

args.detail: Oxygen concentrator without power; on portable tank, duration unknown (caller estimate 2-3h, uncertain); 5th floor walk-up; no breathing trouble at 16:32.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Listo. Usted es la primera en la lista. Darnell, un vecino con generador, y Tanya, de la asociación, van a ir a verla. También llame a su compañía de oxígeno; tienen línea de veinticuatro horas.
turns.gloss: Done. You're first on the list. Darnell, a neighbor with a generator, and Tanya from the association will come see you. Also call your oxygen company; they have a 24-hour line.

turns.speaker: alvarez
turns.text: Gracias, mijo. Oiga, ¿y es verdad que el agua está envenenada? Lo dijeron en el radio.
turns.gloss: Thank you, dear. Listen, is it true the water is poisoned? They said it on the radio.

result.finding: No boil-water or do-not-drink advisory found for this area

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Revisé la página oficial del Departamento de Agua de la ciudad a las cuatro y treinta y tres: no hay ningún aviso sobre el agua. Si sale algo oficial, se lo avisamos. Tome agua y quédese en el cuarto más fresco.
turns.gloss: I checked the city's official water department page at 4:33: there's no water advisory. If anything official comes out, we'll tell you. Drink water and stay in the coolest room.
